mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM farm_member WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM farm_member WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm_member ( farm_name, representative_name, username, password, created_at, phone_number, email, farm_address, farm_address_detail, main_crop, farm_description, certified_at, farm_business_number, certification_status ) VALUES ( #{farmName}, #{representativeName}, #{username}, #{password}, NOW(), #{phoneNumber}, #{email}, #{farmAddress}, #{farmAddressDetail}, #{mainCrop}, #{farmDescription}, #{certifiedAt}, #{farmBusinessNumber}, #{certificationStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE farm_member SET representative_name = #{representativeName}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, farm_address = #{farmAddress}, farm_address_detail = #{farmAddressDetail}, main_crop = #{mainCrop}, farm_description = #{farmDescription}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
